market.question: Will the lowest temperature in Seoul be 10°C on May 10?

assessment.reasoning: Forecast for Incheon Intl Airport (RKSI) low on May 10, 2026 is around 10°C (50°F) per meteoblue and weather-forecast. Market resolves Yes if rounded daily low equals 10°C. With same-day forecast bias of ±1-2°C, the bucket centered on the forecast value carries ~30-40% mass.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether actual KMA-station low rounds to 9°C or 11°C instead.
